security: Public open-source metadata only; never commit tokens, personal data or secrets.

identity.gitee: stable project ID preferred; normalized URL fallback
identity.aliases: verify forks, mirrors and renames before treating as distinct

rules.valid_baseline: complete snapshot that passed source completeness checks

gitee_hot.ranking: verify actual sort: list position is not a 24h trending rank
gitee_hot.note: Select recently active items only from verified official hot-project pages; compare dated snapshots for star deltas. Never use generic Explore recommendation as official daily trending.
